'''Ursolan''' is an area in [[Azshara]] just east of [[Timbermaw Hold]]. It is characterized by a deep scar running through the middle of it. Ursolan is now the site of an extensive [[Timbermaw Hold (faction)|Timbermaw]] [[furbolg]] settlement, which runs south through [[Timbermaw Hold]] to [[Bear's Head]]. Ursolan leads up the mountains to the [[Maw of Ursoc]].

Ursolan's namesake is [[Ursol]], a [[Kalimdor]] [[bear]] [[demigod]] revered by the [[furbolg]] race.
